## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: S-6 is the next action, and
   S-4, S-5 are done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/S.yaml`):
   - Security plan and continuous monitoring strategy complete (S-4, S-5).
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what S-6 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   S-6 feeds MS-B (Milestone B, milestone); what it
   records must be ready for that event.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step S
   (Select) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: S-6`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Write the outputs** in `## Outputs`, each file whole (INV-8), every claim traced per
   `_shared/tagging-and-traceability.md`:
   - **ART-SSP** (System Security Plan, updated): Read `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, append `S-6` to
     `touched_by`, add a `## Plan Review and Approval (S-6)` section with what this task
     established, and write the whole file back. Keep every earlier section.
     Rewrite `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/ssp-controls.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/ssp-records.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/ssp-records.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/plan-reviews.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/plan-reviews.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
   Why: `rmf status` counts S-6 done only when every output lists it in `touched_by`.
5. **Leave `facts.yaml` alone.** S-6 writes no facts (INV-4).
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task S-6`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Interviews

| Persona | Role | Interview |
|---|---|---|
| PER-AODR (Authorizing Official Designated Representative) | R | start here |
| PER-PRIV (Component Privacy Officer) | R | start here, only when the system processes PII |
| PER-AO (Authorizing Official) | A | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-RE (Risk Executive Function) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-CIO (DoD Component Chief Information Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-MDA (Milestone Decision Authority) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-CISO (DoD Component Chief Information Security Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |

At least 1 interview(s) with `task: S-6`. Never make a persona answer
outside its role; ask the persona who would know, or record an assumption.

## Inputs

- ART-SSP (System Security Plan): `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml`, `artifacts/data/ssp-records.yaml`, `artifacts/data/plan-reviews.yaml`
- ART-CONMON (Continuous monitoring strategy): `artifacts/ART-CONMON.md`, `artifacts/data/conmon.yaml`
- ART-RA (System risk assessment): `artifacts/ART-RA.md`, `artifacts/data/ra.yaml`, `artifacts/data/protection.yaml`, `artifacts/data/st-protection.yaml`
- Only these: do not open other run files (`00-run-protocol.md`, step 4).

|---|---|---|

| `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml` | — | schema `ssp-controls`, rewritten whole when changed |
| `artifacts/data/ssp-records.yaml` | — | schema `ssp-records`, rewritten whole when changed |
| `artifacts/data/plan-reviews.yaml` | — | schema `plan-reviews`, rewritten whole when changed |

## Facts

S-6 writes no facts.

## Done when

- Security and privacy plans reflecting the controls needed to protect the system and its environment commensurate with risk are reviewed and approved by the AO (DoDI 8510.01 Table 3 outcome).
- ART-SSP records the AO's approval (or the changes required before approval), and `approvals` in ssp-records.yaml holds each approver's full name, system role, title, signature and date, with the concurrences.
- conmon.yaml records the AO's or AODR's approval of the monitoring strategy, if S-5 did not, with conmon.yaml rewritten whole (ISCM-004).
- For a system processing PII, the senior agency official for privacy (PER-PRIV) has reviewed and approved the privacy plan before it went to the AO or AODR, recorded in ssp-records.yaml privacy_plan.approvals (PRIV-012).
- `artifacts/ART-SSP.md` lists S-6 in `touched_by`.
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: S-6`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task S-6` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task S-6`, naming what the outputs now hold.
- A fix that took more than one `rmf check` round gets a RETRY entry and a lesson
  (`_shared/journaling-and-lessons.md`).
